newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted at mixed levels on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted at mixed levels on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mixed levels at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange Friday.
No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, Lower Ohio River, next week, bid 115 percent of tariff, up five percentage points, no offer.
- Two barges, Mississippi River (Osceola through Cairo), next week, bid 97-1/2 percent, unchanged, no offer.
- One barge, Illinois (Pekin), on station, no bid, offered 200 percent, down 10 percentage points.
- Five barges, scattered even mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), 30-day open, bid 165 percent - up five percentage points, no offer.
- Five barges, scattered even mid-Mississippi, 30-day open, bid 162-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points, offered 165 percent, unchanged.
- Four barges, Lower Ohio, one each week of February, bid 115 percent, offered 125 percent.
- Four barges, Illinois, two each week of February 16 and 23, no bid, offered at 162-1/2 percent.
